mainEntity.name: Do I need a permit to install a water feature in Los Angeles?

acceptedAnswer.text: Permit requirements for water feature installation in Los Angeles depend on the size, depth, and specific features of the project. Smaller, self-contained fountains typically do not require permits. However, larger projects involving significant excavation, electrical work, plumbing, or features exceeding certain dimensions (e.g., depth over 18-24 inches) may necessitate permits from the Los Angeles Department of Building and Safety. Our team assists clients in determining permit needs and navigating the application process to ensure compliance.
